title: Planet Coaster 2
notes: Tested on an Apple M5 Pro MacBook Pro running macOS 27.0.1 with Highball 0.10.10. Tested with engine x64-crossover26.3-r18 and renderer d3dmetal (D3DMetal 4.0 beta 2). The launch log explicitly confirms
issues: The game process starts and remains running, but no Planet Coaster 2 window ever appears. After several minutes the Mac becomes increasingly unresponsive and eventually requires a restart.
